hypotheses.C1_exact_hybrid_recomposition: At every layer boundary and corpus, the all-base and all-changed hybrid logits agree with independent native forwards to maximum absolute error at most 1e-4.
hypotheses.C2_nonresidual_carriers_are_material: Before the final boundary, embedding plus value-bus absolute Shapley projection reaches at least 0.20 at some layer on every corpus.
hypotheses.C3_embedding_stream_is_material: The embedding stream has absolute Shapley projection at least 0.10 at some layer on every corpus.
hypotheses.C4_value_bus_is_material: The persistent Layer-0 value bus has absolute Shapley projection at least 0.10 at some layer on every corpus.
hypotheses.C5_late_residual_is_nearly_sufficient: At the Layer-10 boundary, the changed residual with base embedding and value bus has Fisher fidelity at least 0.75 on every corpus.
hypotheses.C6_carrier_depth_profiles_transfer_ood: For each carrier, its 12-layer signed Shapley profile has Spearman correlation at least 0.70 between FineWeb and both OOD corpora.
hypotheses.C7_carrier_interaction_or_cancellation_i: At some pre-final boundary on every corpus, the sum of absolute carrier Shapley projections is at least 1.20.
hypotheses.C8_final_boundary_collapses_to_residual: After Layer 11, residual-only fidelity is at least 0.999 and embedding/value-bus Shapley magnitudes are at most 1e-5 on every corpus.
